text:
ria: Heads-up — Porto region greenfield bring-up: we're running a 6h soak + load ramp next Tue 03/24 02:00-08:00 UTC. Primary goals: validate autoscaler behavior under sustained burst, confirm KV prefix caching effectiveness, and network egress stability.

devin: Thanks. Can we confirm GPU pool size and instance types? Also need list of canary models + seq len targets.

ria: GPU pool = 64 A100s (8 nodes x 8g). Canary models = redwood-small (8k context), redwood-medium (32k), opt-llama-13b sim. Seq len targets: 128 (typical), 1024 (heavy), 4096 (stress).

samira: Oncall checklist: make sure healthcheck TTL = 10s, pod restart backoff at 60s, and netpol allows exporter scraping. I'll watch linkerd and calico flaps.

aj: Opsbot triggered cluster boot: @opsbot please run cluster-priming script now.

opsbot: cluster-priming started at 1885234569. Actions: mount NFS volumes, apply kubelet flags, pre-pull images for canaries. ETA 4m.

mike: Autoscaler config we plan to test (suggested):
```
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: gpu_utilization
      targetAverageUtilization: 65
minReplicas: 2
maxReplicas: 64
behavior:
  scaleUp:
    stabilizationWindowSeconds: 30
    policies:
      - type: Percent
        value: 100
        periodSeconds: 60
  scaleDown:
    stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
```
Tune notes: start with target 65% GPU util, aggressive scale-up 100% per min during burst, conservative scale-down.

devin: For batching: enable continuous batching w/ max_batch_ms=9 and per-model batching factor. We'll record token/sec and p50/p95 latency.

ria: Test plan quick: 1) Smoke (10m) — basic requests, 2) Ramp (30m) — ramp to 50% of target QPS, 3) Soak (5h) — hold at target QPS with intermittent bursts, 4) Stress (30m) — 2x burst to spike autoscaler.

samira: Observability points: ensure traces include node_id, batch_size, kernel_variant. Add alert: GPUUtil > 90% for 5m -> severity P1. Net egress error rate > 1% for 10m -> warn.

natalie: Finance note: reserved capacity delta vs burstable: expected spend +18% if we keep dedicated for 24h. Recommend enable burst credits and watch `cost/burn` dashboard.

aj: small network check: run this command to validate MTU & dataplane:
```
# on host
sudo ethtool -k eth0 | grep mtu
ip link set dev eth0 mtu 9000
ping -s 8972 -M do 10.0.1.1 -c 3
```

devin: During soak watch p95 latency, batch sizes, and `kv_cache_hit_rate`. If kv_cache_hit_rate < 85% after 1h, we'll add prefix caching warmup.

ria: Handoff at end: eng-infra will own cluster for 12h post-soak, eng-sre picks up for 48h. Deliverables: pass smoke, no P1 alerts for 1h, sustained kv hit >=85%.

samira: Quick failure scenario & rollback: if autoscaler fails to scale or GPU OOMs, set `autoscaler.maxReplicas=0` to prevent further scale? (typo) — actually command: `kubectl patch hpa autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":2}}'` then divert traffic to eu-west fallback via router rule.

mike: Add routing policy in prod-router: prefer region=porto with `max_failover=2` and 2m fallback TTL.

opsbot: soak-runner: ramp phase started at 1885234588. Current injected QPS=420, target QPS=840.

ria: Metrics snapshot 00:45 into soak (from grafana): GPU util p50=62%, p95=88%, batch_size median=12, kv_cache_hit_rate=78%, p95 latency=310ms. :warning:

devin: kv cache low — that's expected until warmup. Start warmup job: `./scripts/warmup_prefixes --models=redwood-medium,redwood-small --q=200`

opsbot: warmup job accepted, job_id=wu-1885234595.

samira: Network hiccup detected — 0.6% packet loss on node gpu-03 for 3m. I'm routing exporter to avoid that node for new pods. :eyes:

aj: I'm forcing a rolling drain of g-03: `kubectl drain g-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` then cordon.

devin: After drain, p95 latency improved to 265ms and kv_cache_hit_rate climbed to 86% within 20m. :+1:

natalie: Cost update after 2h: projected hourly burn +22% during soak relative to baseline. Approve for now, but flag for post-mortem.

ria: Decision: continue soak but cap maxReplicas to 48 to limit cost. mike, apply patch.

mike: patched autoscaler maxReplicas=48. Confirmed.

opsbot: soak-runner: stress phase scheduled in 30m. Reminder: set pager to eng-sre@oncall for that window.

samira: Pager set. Eng-sre oncall ready. Will escalate to infra if GPU flakiness repeats.

devin: Post-soak checklist: collect kernels summary: `./tools/kernel-report --since 6h > /tmp/kern-report.txt` and upload to runbook.

ria: Summary for handoff once soak ends:
- smoke passed
- 1 P1 (network packet loss) -> mitigated via drain
- kv cache warmup required but reached target
- scaled to max 46 nodes during peak
- cost overshoot ~+20%

ria: tagging owners: @devin (runtime tuning), @samira (sre follow-up), @mike (autoscaler config), @natalie (cost PM)

mike: Adding runbook PR: https://git.internal/rw/runbooks/porto-soak (will open now) :thumbsup:

ria: Great work team. Post-mortem scheduled Thu 03/26 16:00 UTC. :calendar:

opsbot: soak-runner completed at 1885234819. Summary: soak=6h, peakQPS=910, incidents=1 (network), actions=drain+warmup. Report uploaded to /var/artifacts/porto-soak-1885234819.json

samira: Closing thread, will file incident report with root cause once linkerd/cni logs are analyzed.

ria: Thanks all. :rocket:
